crossRefs.note: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then…
The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”
Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over…
Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
“Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your…
Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in…
Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need, before you ask him.
Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

translations.web: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
translations.bsb: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
translations.kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
translations.asv: And call no man your father on the earth: for one is your Father, even he who is in heaven.
